messages:
Sam: Quick sync — working on the Terraform module + ref-arch for the Azure Marketplace listing. Need infra signoff and SI templates. Anyone able to do a quick review? PR: https://github.com/redwood/terraform-modules/pull/87 :eyes:

Lena: Dropping in — can you paste the module snippet? I'll run static checks.

Sam: ```hcl
module "redwood_azure_marketplace" {
  source  = "github.com/redwood/terraform-modules/azure-marketplace//modules/marketplace"
  version = "v0.1.0"

  resource_group_name = var.resource_group_name
  enable_private_endpoint = false # example, override for private deployments
}
```

Lena: LGTM at a glance. Small concern: networking defaults expose 443/80 — we should include an example for `enable_private_endpoint = true` and a note about NSG rules. I'll run tfsec too.

Raj: For Dedicated customers, please add an instance-type mapping and perf notes in the README. Also pin the model version in the example so marketplace reviewers see a stable reference. cc @Yuki for listing metadata.

Yuki: Heads up — Marketplace intake requires SAS token, listing metadata, and logo assets by EOD Monday. We also need a one-pager reference architecture (png/svg). Please pin supported regions.

Sam: I can add the diagram and region list. Timeline check: if infra review is done by Friday we can submit the marketplace intake for the co-marketing week after next.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview created for PR #87 — https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/87 :white_check_mark:

Lena: Opening an infra ticket for the private endpoint example and security defaults. Ticket ENGINFRA-321 and assigned to eng-infra.

Jon: PSI integrator here — for SI templates we need an ARM (Gov) example and a CloudFormation translation for AWS marketplace customers. Can we include those in `examples/`?

Sam: Good call. I'll add ARM and CFN examples and a short HOWTO for partners (`examples/arm/`, `examples/cloudformation/`).

Yuki: :thumbsup: I'll collect the marketplace metadata and logo pack. Can someone drop the expected model size / context so I can fill the listing form?

Raj: Typical test config: 8k context. Perf tests ran on A100-40GB and T4 for baseline. I'll add a perf notes section with token/sec and recommended instance types.

Sam: OK checklist: 1) merge TF module PR 2) add `enable_private_endpoint` example 3) add ARM/CFN examples 4) upload logo + metadata 5) diagram + README updates 6) resolve ENGINFRA-321 7) submit intake. Targeting Friday for items 1-6.

Yuki: Added intake slot to calendar — Fri 11:00 PT.

Sam: Thanks. Quick ask — anyone available to review the ARM example tomorrow morning? @Jon?

Jon: I can do 10am PT tomorrow.

Lena: Assign review to me after Jon's pass, I'll focus on security defaults and NSG rules.

Sam: :thumbsup: Will update the PR with the private endpoint example and ping reviewers when ready.

Raj: I'll update the README with perf notes and a recommended mapping table.

Yuki: Great — keeping this thread for final checklist. If anyone finds blocking issues put them in the PR comments and ENGINFRA-321.

Sam: Thanks all, appreciate the quick turnaround.
